fusions.name: Inked Pawprint
fusions.desc: A quick swipe that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Clawed to Confetti
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Claws through the target for 22 damage and tears up every affliction you have on it, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Quiet in the Stacks
fusions.desc: Hides you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Ninth Draft
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
